title: Deferred Failover Runbook Designer — Private Console flow
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Private/VPC customers need a predictable, auditable way to define and rehearse multi-cluster failover and maintenance runbooks that respect tenant SLA, cost constraints, and network topology. Current console pages show cluster status and connectivity graphs but lack an interactive authoring surface to compose sequences, delays, dependencies and safe rollback steps for zero-downtime upgrades or emergency failovers.

What this ticket builds: a Failover Runbook Designer embedded in the Private Console that lets operators: author step-by-step playbooks (eg. drain node group A, cut traffic to region B, promote backup cluster C), schedule deferred windows, attach prechecks/postchecks, and simulate the runbook against live topology and synthetic traffic. The designer surfaces SLO impact, estimated token-cost delta (eg. additional cross-region egress), and a confidence score driven by historical telemetry.

Key UX features to prototype: timeline lane editor with drag-to-reorder steps; conditional branches (eg. if precheck fails -> abort and alert); network-path risk overlay (heatmap per step); canary step generator with parameter presets; a "what-if" slider to simulate latency/cost trade-offs; compact audit trail panel with required approvers and links to associated PRs/Playbooks.

Design constraints and trade-offs: keep primary authoring flow simplified for small ops teams while exposing advanced conditional logic behind an "expert mode" toggle. Prefer visual primitives over textual scripts to reduce errors, but provide an exportable JSON/YAML runbook for infra automation (hand-off to ENG). Tight coupling with telemetry and rollout systems raises security review requirements (privileged actions). We will gate execution behind RBAC and two-step approvals.

Deliverables for this ticket: high-fidelity flow in Figma for the designer surface (desktop), an interactive prototype demonstrating a 3-step failover with simulation controls, copy for inline help and approver modal, and an accessibility pass for keyboard-first editing. Include a short PRD summary for Eng handoff listing API contracts and telemetry queries needed for confidence scoring.
acceptance_criteria: Figma screens for timeline editor, step inspector, simulation panel, and approval modal reviewed and approved by PM and Eng
Prototype demonstrates creating, scheduling, and simulating a 3-step runbook against a sample private cluster topology
Audit trail UI shows approver list, timestamps, and links to related PRs/dashboards
Design spec includes required telemetry queries and RBAC states for Eng implementation
Accessibility checklist completed: keyboard-only reorder, ARIA labels for timeline lanes, color contrast checks passed
